settings.annual_weighting: Each annual mean has equal regression weight; song exposure weights remain inside the exposure-weighted annual means.
settings.estimand: OLS linear change per decade on the common 0-1 scale; not the earlier Theil-Sen estimator or a constant year-by-year change.
settings.newey_west: Bartlett kernel; finite-sample covariance correction; t inference with n_years-2 degrees of freedom.
settings.bootstrap: Circular fixed-length blocks of centered, detrended OLS residuals; fixed years. Basic 95% intervals; two-sided null p-values from centered slope errors, with plus-one Monte Carlo correction.
settings.multiplicity: Holm within each method/window: three primary v2.1 token dimensions; three paired version contrasts; and separately all comparisons. An additional correction covers the entire method/window test battery. Confidence intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous.
settings.primary: Matched-all-variants songs, debut year, exposure weighting, v2.1 tokens.
settings.selection: Retrospective checks after viewing the trends, not preregistered tests. All windows are reported; no window chosen for its p-value.

limitations: Failure to reject zero is not evidence of equivalence or no meaningful change.
HAC and block inference are approximate with only about seven decades of observations.
Block resampling assumes approximately stationary, weakly dependent detrended residuals; HAC allows heteroskedasticity but cannot remove arbitrary long-memory dependence.

These tests condition on observed annual means and their lyric-covered population; they do not independently resample songs, correct artist clusters, repair missing lyrics, validate emotion constructs, or establish causality.
An average linear trend can conceal nonlinear or period-specific changes. Sensitivity series share songs and are not independent replications.
